initialUserIntent: Adopt Tier A from the Cursor-feature domain research (bdd-ts-domain-expert report SRC-2026-08-17-001..005): read-only Changes diff with hunk-level review and exact-range open-through-editor, as the first slice.

approvedChanges.statement: The user approved the architectural decision: Pi is, in the future, ONE of the usable agents in the IDE, not the sole AI/model authority. This unlocks provider/model flexibility candidates in Tier B/C and requires an ADR; it does NOT create a duplicate REQ-IDE-AI-CHAT requirement now.
approvedChanges.evidence: User message: 'cmq PI dovrebbe essere, in futuro, uno degli agenti utilizzabili'

requirement.title: Read-only Changes diff review with exact-range editor open
requirement.capability: From an existing workspace Changes status, produce file/hunk-level read-only diffs and open an exact diff range through the existing editor; no staging/commit/checkout/revert authority in v1.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given an open workspace with a modified file, the Changes surface shows the file with a read-only hunk-level diff (line/range metadata) without writing to the working tree.
Activating a diff range opens the exact file path and range in the existing editor without creating a new AI/model dependency.

The diff adapter follows extract -> delegate -> response, contains no hidden domain policy, and reports unavailable honestly when the platform cannot produce a diff (anti-fake: no mock-only or hard-coded response).

Boundary invariant: packages/ui, packages/web-core, apps/web never import @tauri-apps/api; browser and Tauri implementations live behind frontend ports (packages/browser-adapters, packages/tauri-adapters, apps/desktop/src-tauri).

requirement.scope: Tier A: diff review slice only; no AI chat, no model/provider flexibility, no terminal execution, no agentic editing.
exclusions: REQ-IDE-AI-CHAT (deferred; Pi-as-one-of-agents decision recorded, no duplicate)
REQ-IDE-AI-CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT-001, REQ-IDE-AI-CONTEXT-POLICY-001, REQ-IDE-CODEBASE-INDEX-001 (sibling Tier A slices, opened later)
Any write authority over the working tree
